function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您查看以下可靠來源：

- **Bloomberg** 或 **Reuters** 的實時行情頁面  
- **Kitco**（https://www.kitco.com/）的黃金價格更新  
- **美國商品期貨交易所（CME）** 的黃金期貨價格  
- 您所在國家的金融新聞網站或投資平台（如 Bloomberg、Reuters、Yahoo Finance 等）

這些平台通常會以美元/盎司（USD/oz）為單位顯示最新價格，並提供歷史走勢圖表。祝您投資順利！

We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can provide a typical price or say we can't fetch real-time. We can also ask for clarification. The user wants the price. We can respond with a disclaimer that we don't have real-time data. We can provide a typical price from a known source like the last known price. But we should not fabricate. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking a reliable source. So answer: "I don't have real-time data, but you can check X."
